head.i: Ejusdem veritatis ex Jesuitarum nonnulla confessione evictio.

main_text.head: SECT. VI.
main_text.p: {p}Enchirid. Tract. de Meritis, cap.7. § Quinta est.COsterus Jesuita, cujus nomen inter Jesuitarum primarios claruit, Papisticam condignitatem totis propugnat viribus, & quæ-stione hùc illùc agitatâ ac vexatâ, postquam definiebat Meritum de Condigno niti æqua-litate justitiæ, quæ Commutativa vel Distributi-va sit, & revera {¶}Ibid. § Ex his, &c.ad utramque justitiæ partem aliquo modo pertinere; tandem eò est redactus angustiarum, ut coactus sit profiteri in verba sequentia, Propositio tertia est, Inter Deum & homines non potest, qualis inter homines, exacta justitia intercedere. 1. Quia non potest Deus eo modo debere nobis, ut, misericordi gratiâ suâ sepositâ, ex re aliqua remaneat nobis obligatus. Cujus tres rationes reddit. page.notes: The symbol before "COsterus" and before "ad" is a printed reference mark, transcribed as p and ¶ respectively; the first one is uncertain [?]. The running head "Cap.16." is kept as printed. The word "Hæc ra-" ends the page and "tio" is the catchword. The italic/roman boundaries in the first paragraph and in the proposition are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The right-hand page is a sliver only and is not transcribed.
